verdict.rationale: Jira is a work-tracking and issue-management product. Reviewing code diffs and leaving line-level comments that an agent then iterates on belongs to code-hosting and review tools such as Bitbucket, which is a separate integrated product, not Jira itself. Nothing in the evidence shows Jira itself offering line-level code review or agent iteration on code, mobile or otherwise, so this axis is a category error for Jira.
